title: A proof's verdict does not depend on the git environment that called it
intention: A proof's sealed verdict is the same whether the tester was called by hand, from a plain-commit hook, or from a `git commit -- <paths>` hook: the caller's GIT_* environment never reaches the proof subject.
why: Builder measured 2026-10-13 on a135's build commit: test_rehearsal.py sealed RED (two scratch-repo commit teeth, 'invalid object ... Error building trees') because the hook's GIT_INDEX_FILE (absolute, the main repo's next-index lock) leaked into the proof; rerun bare it sealed green (fa996c79). A seal that depends on who called the tester is a verdict about the caller, not the component — and a false red is distrusted work, a false green a peer leans on (Law 8). hollow.git_env() already scrubs for the tester's own git calls since the 2026-09-09 measurement of the same cause; the subject env was never scrubbed.
traces_to: Law 3 (a measurement measures the component, not the caller's environment) and Law 8 (a seal a peer leans on must not flip on invocation context).
how: A Haiku builder needs: (a) the one place — _env_pinned_to in cairn/devices/tester/device.py; (b) reuse hollow.git_env()'s scrub (read it at cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, def git_env) rather than a second list — same component, so importing it is inside RULE 1; (c) proof at cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_does_not_inherit_the_callers_git_env.py: a scratch outer repo whose pre-commit hook runs the tester over a tiny subject proof that does `git init` + `git commit` in its own tmp dir; teeth T1-T3; (d) a commit touching device.py triggers the ~40-min reseal of tester proofs — budget for it.
falsifier: Done when a proof that runs git in its own scratch repo seals the same verdict called (T1) bare, (T2) from inside a plain-commit pre-commit hook (GIT_INDEX_FILE=.git/index), and (T3) from inside a `git commit -- <path>` pre-commit hook (GIT_INDEX_FILE=<abs>/next-index-*.lock); T3 reds on the hollow build. Wrong-intent signal: a proof that needed a caller's GIT_* reds after the change.
watchme: none, because the regression event is the reseal fired by cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit, which re-runs the ticket proof on every commit touching the tester
children: none, because it is one scrub in cairn/devices/tester/device.py
intent_berth: none, because a bug enters at TICKET (skills/intent/SKILL.md); the measurement is the builder's a135 build-commit seal and its clean rerun fa996c79 in the cairn repo
